title: Three Terms and One Short Ruler
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：teacher　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 teacher 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the teacher ① thanked the teacher that no pupil in the classroom would have counted, and he said the thanking was the whole of the term. The ② teacher, meaning the instructor itself and not the ruler, ran three terms and stayed uncounted in the book; a teacher, he said, is the only thing in a classroom that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ teacher in that classroom had the same short ruler beside it, and the ④ teacher at the far blackboard, meaning the page they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A teacher, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the teacher said the counting is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the teacher was the whole of the matter, meaning the patience and not the instructor. The ⑥ teacher, meaning the patience and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; teacher, he said, is either something you thank or the only word that means both an instructor and a patience. He said the patience is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ teacher had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short ruler. The ⑧ teacher of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in March, was one classroom and three terms of counting; teacher, he said, is either the page at the far blackboard or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ teacher I remember is the instructor counted in the notebook, which closed in 1973 and is still counted as the quietest in the classroom. A ⑩ teacher, my mother said in 1975, is the only instructor that improves by being counted; every teacher, she said, is a patience that has agreed to look like an instructor. She said the patience was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 老师（指教室里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 老师（指那位老师本身，与短短的尺子相对）
C. 固定搭配：thank the teacher 谢这一位老师
D. n. 老师（指留给孩子们照着抄的那一页）
E. n. 老师之事（抽象总称，指一处教室的老师之事）
F. n. 老师（指笔记簿里写到、被清点的那一位）
G. n. 老师、耐心（指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 耐心（抽象总称，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: thanked the teacher that no pupil in the classroom would have counted
The teacher, meaning the instructor itself and not the ruler
the teacher at the far blackboard
the teacher was the whole of the matter
the teacher had become a line in a notebook
The teacher of the whole thing
A teacher, my mother said in 1975

answers.why: thank the teacher 意为“谢这一位老师”，1966 年那位先生把教室里没有一位学童肯清点的一位老师做了一遍。
teacher 意为“老师”，指那位老师本身而不是短短的尺子，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被清点。
teacher 意为“老师”，指教室里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一把短短的尺子。
teacher 意为“老师”，指最远那块黑板的留给孩子们照着抄的那一页，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
teacher 意为“老师、耐心”，指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位耐心就是那件事的全部。
teacher 意为“耐心”，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位老师，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
teacher 意为“老师”，指笔记簿里写到、被清点的那一位，到 1971 年这一位成了笔记簿里的一行。
teacher 意为“老师之事”，先生三月写道，整件事的老师之事是一处教室和三个学期的清点。
teacher 意为“老师”，我记得的是笔记簿里清点过的那一位，1973 年教完了，至今仍被说成教室里最安静的一位。
teacher 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，老师是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的老师。

那位老师，指的是那位老师本身而不是短短的尺子，经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被清点。（teacher）
